map.示例：某科开放 50 床、统计 30 天、占用 1200 床日、出院 140 人: Example: a department opens 50 beds, over 30 days records 1200 bed-days and discharges 140 patients
map.科室月度运营统计：按平均开放床位数与统计天数算出实际开放总床日数，再用实际占用床: Department monthly operations: compute the total available bed-days from the average open beds and the number of days, then divide actual occupied bed-days by it to get the bed occupancy rate and judge whether resource use sits in the reasonable 85-93% band.
map.结合出院人数算床位周转次数（出院人数 ÷ 平均开放床位）与平均住院日（占用床日: Combine with discharges to compute bed turnover count (discharges / average open beds) and average length of stay (occupied bed-days / discharges), revealing case mix structure and operational efficiency.
map.计算医院床位使用率、床位周转次数、平均住院日等核心运营指标，评估床位资源配置效率: Compute core operational metrics such as hospital bed occupancy, bed turnover count and average length of stay to assess bed allocation efficiency.
map.：开放总床日 = 50 × 30 = 1500；使用率 = 1200 ÷ 150: : total available bed-days = 50 x 30 = 1500; utilisation = 1200 / 1500 x 100% = 80.0% (low); turnover count = 140 / 50 = 2.80 (normal); average length of stay = 1200 / 140 = 8.57 days (short); turnover days = 30 / 2.80 = 10.71 days.
